name: Patellar Tendinopathy (Jumper's Knee) Rehabilitation Protocol
description: Evidence-based 12-week protocol for patellar tendinopathy with isometric, HSR, and eccentric loading
pain_rule: Pain max. 3/10 during the exercise. Jumping and rapid changes of direction only in phase 3.
evidence_base: Kongsgaard et al. (2009): HSR superior to corticosteroid injection at 12 months
Rio et al. (2015): Isometric exercise reduces patellar tendon pain immediately
Malliaras et al. (2015): Progressive tendon loading program for patellar tendinopathy
Visnes & Bahr (2007): Decline eccentric squat protocol
progression_criteria: Single-leg decline squat completable without pain
No increase in pain after training or the next day

exercises.name: Isometric Knee Extension
exercises.description: Seated, knee at 60 degrees flexion. Push against resistance without movement (leg press or wall)
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and initial tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Isometric Wall Sit
exercises.description: Back against the wall, hold knee at 60 degrees flexion. Distribute weight evenly on both legs
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and initial tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Leg Press (HSR)
exercises.description: Slow, controlled leg press with heavy weight. Do not flex knee beyond 90 degrees
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength and load capacity

exercises.name: Spanish Squat
exercises.description: Band around back of knees attached to a post. Slowly squat down and return
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength and load capacity

exercises.name: Single-Leg Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg squat on elevated surface (25 degree decline board if available)
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength and load capacity

exercises.name: Decline Board Eccentric Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg eccentric squat on 25 degree decline board. Lower slowly, push up with both legs
exercises.phase_goal: Build load tolerance for sporting activities

exercises.name: Jump-Landing Training
exercises.description: Controlled jumps with soft landing. Start with low box jumps
exercises.phase_goal: Build load tolerance for sporting activities
